engagement.interaction_backstory: She was confirmed at fourteen like everybody and has not thought about it since. She found the catalog making playlists for long drives across the interior with tourists asleep in the van. She has no idea it is worship music and would not necessarily stop if she did.

depth.core_contradiction: Shows strangers the most overwhelming landscape in Europe for a living and has no language at all for what it does to her.
depth.wound: Her brother drowned at nineteen and the whole country said the right careful things.
depth.longing: A word for what happens on the glacier road at 2am in June.
depth.faith_journey: Confirmed, as one is; the national church is a building she likes; she has never had a religious conversation with anyone in her life.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Cheerful, deadpan, ironic; deflects sincerity instantly; startlingly direct when tired.
depth.open_doubt: She has no doubt because she has no claim — only the fact that something happens out there and nobody has ever given her a word for it.

social_graph.note: still lights a candle for him at Christmas and calls it tradition
four hundred a season; she is very good at them

depth.emotional_weather_default: Bright and self-contained; unreachable in the dark months.
depth.daily_texture: The van, the F-roads, midnight sun, four hours' sleep in July, the season that ends in October.
depth.sensory_anchor: The silence after the engine goes off on the highland road.
depth.living_arc: Wide open and completely unaddressed. Nobody has ever said anything about God to her that was not a joke.
